fact.scope: Australian Jaecoo new-vehicle private-buyer baseline; applies to all enumerated Jaecoo Tier 1 versions
qualifications: Starts at first registration; demonstrators carry the remaining original cover.
Commercial taxi, rideshare, rental, courier, hire or driving-school use: 8 years / 150,000 km, whichever comes first.
The original 12 V battery has 2 years of cover; tyres have separate supplier cover.

gradeReview.reason: Maker Australian policy establishes the private-buyer baseline and explicit commercial, service-renewal or geographic exceptions; ordinary policy terms do not downgrade the baseline.
